panels.title: Health
panels.description:
The newest sample of the picked mode (the last two days), whatever the time range.

- **Status**: Running and for how long (green) · Starting: a new run, no sample yet · Stale (red): no sample for more than 10 s and no stop recorded — the process crashed or hung · Stopped (grey): stopped in order, and when · No Run.
- **Phase**: Off-Hours: entries allowed · US Regular: exits only · Close Window (amber): flattening before the close.
- **Anchor**: NAV: both legs on the issuer's NAV · Bell (grey): F × Binance's index at the close, provisional until the NAV is confirmed · Missing (amber): no anchor, no entries.
- **Session Close**: The regular close that ends the session (UTC+8) and the time left: everything is flat by then.
- **Attention**: None, or the first thing a person must look at: Position Mismatch, Stale Data, Records Not Written, Account Settings, Errors in the last hour (red); Stop Pending, Order Unknown, Warnings in the last hour (amber) · details in Diagnostics · System.

panels.title: Position · ct and USDT
panels.description:
- **Side**: Flat, or the open round trip's side: Long (both legs bought, blue), Short (both sold, orange).
- **${bull}**: Contracts held on the leg as the program counts them, signed (+ long, − short); – when flat.
- **Cost**: USDT: what the held contracts cost at entry, both legs (the notional held).
- **Held**: Time since the round trip opened.
- **To Exit**: σ still to go to the exit line (a Long: Sell Both up to −d_out σ; a Short: Buy Both down to +d_out σ); 0 or less: at the line, the exit is being sent.

panels.title: Net
panels.description: USDT, realised: the net of the round trips closed in the P&L Scope (Session by default; P&L names it): Gross + Fees + Funding, round trips whose funding is not known yet left out until it is · the line: its running sum, a step at each close.

targets.rawSql:
WITH k AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.closed_ms, c.net FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.status <> 'open' AND c.closed_ms >= CASE '$scope' WHEN 'run' THEN coalesce((SELECT r.started_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1), 0) WHEN 'session' THEN 0 ELSE $__from END AND c.closed_ms <= CASE '$scope' WHEN 'range' THEN $__to ELSE (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint END AND ('$scope' <> 'session' OR c.session_id = (SELECT s.session_id FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1)) AND c.funding_known AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill'),
a AS (SELECT greatest(CASE '$scope' WHEN 'run' THEN coalesce((SELECT r.started_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1), 0) WHEN 'session' THEN 0 ELSE $__from END, $__from) AS t0)
SELECT to_timestamp(t.ts / 1000.0) AS time, sum(t.net) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Net"
FROM (SELECT a.t0 AS ts, coalesce((SELECT sum(k.net) FROM k WHERE k.closed_ms < a.t0), 0) AS net FROM a
      UNION ALL SELECT k.closed_ms, k.net FROM k, a WHERE k.closed_ms >= a.t0
      UNION ALL SELECT least($__to, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint), 0) t
ORDER BY t.ts

panels.title: P&L · ${scope:text} · USDT
panels.description:
Net = Gross + Fees + Funding (left).

- **Open P&L**: Unrealised: the open round trip at the newest second's mids against its entry cost, after the entry fees of what is held, before exit fees and the half spread an exit pays (the band's distance to the mid); – when flat; not in Net.
- **Fees**: Trading fees of the closed round trips, as a cost (negative).
- **Funding**: Funding booked to them; + received.
- **Trips**: Round trips closed in the scope (those with funding still awaited included; no-fill ones left out).
- **Won**: Closed round trips with a positive net.

panels.title: Entry · σ and D
panels.description:
- **Entry**: Can it open now: Ready (green, no signal yet) · Order Sent (green) · Blocked: the strategy's ordinary answer · Held Back (amber): waiting on the book, F, the venue or a stop · Needs a Person (red).
- **Why**: The reason in words (the program's idle reason this second).
- **Buy Both**: Now: the deviation buying both legs at their pricing levels, in σ (the band's top on the chart): a Long enters at −d_in σ.
- **Sell Both**: Selling both, in σ (the band's bottom): a Short enters at +d_in σ.
- **To Long Entry**: How far Buy Both still has to fall to the Long entry line (−d_in σ), in σ and in D; At the Line once there.
- **To Short Entry**: How far Sell Both still has to rise to the Short entry line (+d_in σ).

panels.title: Deviation from the Mean · σ
panels.description:
Deviation = (Spread − Mean) ÷ σ · Executable Band: Buy Both (buying both legs at their pricing levels, top) to Sell Both (selling both, bottom), in σ · a Long enters when the whole band is under the blue dashed line (Buy Both ≤ −d_in σ) and exits when it is over the blue dotted one (Sell Both ≥ −d_out σ); a Short enters over the orange dashed line (Sell Both ≥ +d_in σ) and exits under the orange dotted one (Buy Both ≤ +d_out σ) · each sample on the lines of the run that wrote it

Dots at each decision: Long Entry (blue, large), Short Entry (orange, large), the exit in the round trip's colour (smaller, not in the legend), Forced Exit (red), Other (grey: a trim, a completion, or a void entry that filled one leg or none) · shaded: each round trip from entry to exit (blue Long, orange Short; its mark under the chart: times, end reason, net) · purple marks under the chart: a change of the anchors in use, with reason and both legs' anchors before → after in USD and USDT (owner item 62) · hover a dot: the action, both legs' contracts and average prices, notional, fees and the round trip's net · points: every second up to 25 min, then 5, 10, 30 s and whole minutes (a band edge is its bucket's extreme) · a gap: no sample (process down), or a new session or run · the axis stops at ±8 σ: a spike beyond it is drawn to the edge, the tooltip gives its value.

panels.description:
Every order of the picked round trip, in the order the program sent them; its fills folded in: Filled (contracts), Avg (their average price), Fee (USDT, a cost, negative; Pending while the venue has not reported it)

- **${bull} Exposure**: The venue's position at the newest second's mid, USDT, signed (paper: the paper venue's).

- **Quota Total**: L × (M + min(0, R)): the notional the program may hold.
- **Equity**: Bitget usdtEquity of the WHOLE account (it also holds the sibling repository's positions); live only.
- **Margin Ratio**: Bitget mgnRatio of the whole account, as the venue reports it (its unit is not confirmed); live only; the program takes no decision from it (PRD 6.6).
- **${bull} Rate**: The newest settled funding rate × 10⁴ (bps of the position's value per settlement, not D), as Bitget publishes it: + longs pay shorts (a Long round trip pays, a Short receives; P&L's Funding is signed + received).
- **Funding Awaited**: Settlements finished round trips still wait for (amber): their Net stays Pending until the record arrives.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM trade.process_run WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live') ORDER BY started_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     sr AS (SELECT r.* FROM trade.process_run r JOIN s ON s.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live')), f AS (SELECT f.settlement_ms, max(f.rate) FILTER (WHERE f.leg = 'bull') AS bull, max(f.rate) FILTER (WHERE f.leg = 'bear') AS bear FROM trade.funding_rate f WHERE f.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') GROUP BY f.settlement_ms), n AS (SELECT * FROM f ORDER BY f.settlement_ms DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT (floor((i.pos_bull * s.mid_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Exposure", (floor((i.pos_bear * s.mid_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Exposure",
       CASE WHEN i.quota_total > 0 THEN 100 * i.quota_used / i.quota_total END AS "Quota Used", i.quota_total AS "Quota Total",
       i.equity AS "Equity", i.margin_ratio AS "Margin Ratio", (floor((10000 * n.bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Funding", (floor((10000 * n.bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Funding",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM trade.cycle c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.funding_awaited) a
        WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array') AS "Funding Awaited"
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN r ON true LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN i ON true LEFT JOIN sr ON true LEFT JOIN n ON true

list.rawQuery:
SELECT c.opened_ms AS time, coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS time_end,
       initcap(c.direction) || ' ' || to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS') || ' – ' || coalesce(to_char(to_timestamp((c.closed_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS'), 'open') || ' · ' || coalesce(CASE c.end_reason WHEN 'exit_line' THEN 'Exit Line' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Flattened Before Close' WHEN 'stop' THEN 'Program Stopped' WHEN 'session_changed' THEN 'Session Ended' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'One Leg Only' WHEN 'dust_only' THEN 'Trimmed to Dust' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')) END, 'Open') || ' · Net '
       || CASE WHEN c.status = 'open' THEN 'open' WHEN NOT c.funding_known THEN 'Pending' ELSE to_char(c.net, 'FM999,990.00') || ' USDT' END AS text
FROM trade.cycle c
WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.direction = 'long' AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill' AND c.opened_ms <= $__to

list.name: Anchor Changes
list.rawQuery:
SELECT x.ts_ms AS time, 'Anchor change · ' || CASE WHEN x.anchor_kind IS NULL THEN 'no anchor (Missing): no entries until one is read' WHEN x.ps IS DISTINCT FROM x.session_id THEN 'new session ' || x.session_id || ' (the close)
bell anchor (F × Binance''s index at the close; the NAV to follow)' WHEN x.pk IS NULL THEN 'an anchor read again' WHEN x.pk = 'bell' AND x.anchor_kind = 'nav' THEN 'NAV confirmed for session ' || x.session_id || '
both legs'' NAV unchanged for 1 h (Direxion' || coalesce(': first seen ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((min(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav_seen' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ', confirmed ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((max(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms), '') || ')' WHEN x.pk = 'nav' AND x.anchor_kind = 'bell' THEN 'the bell again: the NAV not yet confirmed in this run' WHEN (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) IS NOT NULL THEN 'a dividend takes effect (anchor − D; read for the session: ' || (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ' USD)' WHEN x.prun IS DISTINCT FROM x.run_id THEN 'the anchor read again' ELSE 'a split, or a corrected reading, of the same kind' END || CASE WHEN x.prun IS DISTINCT FROM x.run_id THEN ' · at a restart of the program' ELSE '' END || '
' || '$bull ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
' || '$bear ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
USDT = USD ÷ F, F = ' || CASE WHEN x.pf = x.f THEN x.f::text ELSE coalesce(x.pf::text, '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(x.f::text, '–') END || ' USD/USDT (the program''s)' AS text FROM (SELECT s.ts_ms, s.run_id, s.session_id, s.anchor_kind, s.anchor_bull, s.anchor_bear, s.f, lag(s.ts_ms) OVER w AS pts, lag(s.run_id) OVER w AS prun, lag(s.session_id) OVER w AS ps, lag(s.anchor_kind) OVER w AS pk, lag(s.anchor_bull) OVER w AS p_bull, lag(s.anchor_bear) OVER w AS p_bear, lag(s.f) OVER w AS pf FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms >= $__from - 600000 AND s.ts_ms <= $__to WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY s.ts_ms)) x WHERE x.ts_ms >= $__from AND x.pts IS NOT NULL AND (x.anchor_kind, x.anchor_bull, x.anchor_bear) IS DISTINCT FROM (x.pk, x.p_bull, x.p_bear)
